propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, confidence level, and source type without per-metric scattered code.
Metrics with no data must return Unavailable state carrying a non-empty reason and ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp rather than being absent from output.
The is_authoritative() function must filter out backfill_classified source values to prevent classified/fuzzy data from aggregating into authoritative structural series.
Every REGISTRY entry must have a unique id, a lens, a source, and a confidence; duplicate or missing ids must be caught by unit tests.
The source label must enumerate to {structural, git, sidecar, snapshot, backfill_classified} and the confidence label to {high, classified} on every metric value for downstream aggregation decisions.
